verdict.rationale: Dover documents its own API for adding candidates, fetching jobs, and automating 'various recruitment processes'. Its official MCP server exposes jobs, candidates, applications, and interview workflows. Nothing claims or shows UI parity: many UI-documented functions have no evidenced API equivalent, and the probes found no published OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, a complete API reference or OpenAPI spec, API coverage of UI features such as approvals, permissions, offers, reporting, careers page, job-board posting, bulk actions and settings, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: With the API, you can programmatically add candidates to your jobs, fetch job listings, and automate various recruitment processes.
Set up the Dover MCP server to give AI tools access to jobs, candidates, applications, and interview workflows in Dover.
